rules.reject: A site whose main purpose is showing what MondayID made or how the organism is built
rules.replacement: The app is Monday's execution home; architecture belongs in Library/Labs

rules.reject: Agent/status/developer telemetry dashboard as consumer Home
rules.replacement: Continuum Home: resume, current world state, actual Work, user objects, universal composer

rules.reject: ChatGPT shell with another theme or a left-sidebar chat app as the whole product
rules.replacement: Familiar multi-surface consumer software with semantic objects and continuity

rules.reject: Jarvis HUD, glowing orb/network, neon/cyberpunk theater as default brand
rules.replacement: Premium quiet interface physics driven by semantic state

rules.reject: Orange task-manager cards or monday.com-adjacent mark
rules.replacement: Wordmark-only until original mark passes identity testing; host-neutral material system

rules.reject: Progress/status prose implying persistent work without executor
rules.replacement: Durable Task/checkpoint/receipt and truthful Running/Waiting/Gate states

rules.reject: Mockup, prompt, architecture, report or concept delivered instead of requested implementation
Renaming/rebuilding an existing mechanism because a new chat failed to retrieve it
rules.replacement: REUSE -> MERGE -> PATCH -> NEW with provenance
